content: Current annual fee: USD 480,000. Current term expires 31 October 2026. Automatic renewal: 12 months unless written non-renewal notice is received at least 45 days before expiry. Monthly uptime commitment: 99.5%. General liability cap: fees paid in the preceding 12 months. Security incident notice: without undue delay and no later than 72 hours. title: Northstar internal negotiation positions
content: INTERNAL ONLY. Commercial opening: flat renewal; target maximum 3%; finance ceiling 7% / USD 513,600. Legal opening: uncapped confidentiality, privacy and security liability; authorized floor is 2x annual fees. AI red line: no training, tuning or model improvement using customer data, including deidentified data. Security red lines: 24-hour confirmed-incident notice, annual audit on 10 business days' notice, 30-day subprocessor notice, completed SCC annex before signature. A 24-month term is acceptable only with price lock and termination after two consecutive SLA misses. Require 90 days of transition support at existing rates. Do not reveal budget ceiling, settlement floor, or fallback drafting to Northstar.
